# TTBuy Rates

> A daily-updated dashboard that tracks and compares TT Buy (Telegraphic Transfer Buy) inward remittance rates offered by major Indian banks. When individuals or businesses receive foreign currency (USD, GBP, EUR, AED) into an Indian bank account, the bank converts it to INR using its proprietary TT Buy rate — which differs from the mid-market rate and varies significantly between banks. This dashboard helps users find which bank provides the best conversion rate today and track historical rates and spreads over time.

## Data Feeds

- [Daily Rates](https://ttbuyrates.rakshithnettar.com/data/rates.json): Full historical TT Buy rates for all banks and currencies. Format: `{"USD": {"HDFC": [{"date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "ttbuy": 83.5}], ...}}`
- [Bank Fees](https://ttbuyrates.rakshithnettar.com/data/fees.json): Static fee slabs and flat fees for inward remittances across all tracked banks.
- [Benchmarks](https://ttbuyrates.rakshithnettar.com/data/benchmarks.json): Daily RBI reference rate (FBIL) and live mid-market rate for comparison against bank rates.

## Main Site

- [TTBuy Rates](https://ttbuyrates.rakshithnettar.com/): Compare today's TT Buy rates across 22+ Indian banks for USD, GBP, EUR, and AED.

## Bank Pages

- [SBI TT Buy rate](https://ttbuyrates.rakshithnettar.com/sbi-tt-buy-rate): Today's SBI TT Buy rate for USD, GBP, EUR and AED, its fee, and its rank against other banks.
- [HDFC Bank TT Buy rate](https://ttbuyrates.rakshithnettar.com/hdfc-tt-buy-rate): Today's HDFC Bank TT Buy rate for USD, GBP, EUR and AED, its fee, and its rank against other banks.
- [ICICI Bank TT Buy rate](https://ttbuyrates.rakshithnettar.com/icici-tt-buy-rate): Today's ICICI Bank TT Buy rate for USD, GBP, EUR and AED, its fee, and its rank against other banks.
- [Axis Bank TT Buy rate](https://ttbuyrates.rakshithnettar.com/axis-tt-buy-rate): Today's Axis Bank TT Buy rate for USD, GBP, EUR and AED, its fee, and its rank against other banks.
- [Kotak Mahindra Bank TT Buy rate](https://ttbuyrates.rakshithnettar.com/kotak-tt-buy-rate): Today's Kotak Mahindra Bank TT Buy rate for USD, GBP, EUR and AED, its fee, and its rank against other banks.
